question: What should come in the place of blank number (5)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**momentum**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes incompleteness in infrastructure as not a sign of failure, but as a deliberate strategy that sustains anticipation.
 
• The appropriate noun should reflect the idea of ongoing progress or movement, even if it is not fully realized.
 
• "**Momentum**" fits well as it means the force or speed of movement, which aligns with the idea of indicating continued progress or activity.
